hooks.command: root="$(printf '%s' "${DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR-}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"; [ -n "$root" ] || root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; [ -f "$root/scripts/lisa-enforcement-fallback.sh" ] || { echo "Lisa enforcement dispatcher missing at $root/scripts/lisa-enforcement-fallback.sh; refusing (run lisa apply)" >&2; exit 2; }; payload=$(cat); mapped=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -c 'if (.tool_name | type) == "string" then .tool_name |= ({"exec": "Bash", "write": "Write", "edit": "Edit"}[.] // .) else . end' 2>/dev/null) || mapped=""; [ -n "$mapped" ] || { echo "Lisa could not map the Devin tool name (jq missing or failed); refusing" >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$mapped" | /bin/bash "$root/scripts/lisa-enforcement-fallback.sh"
